screens.screen: game board in mid-play (Player2 / O to move)
WINNER! dialog over the finished board

notes: The app has no menu: only splash -> one game screen (+ the stock skeleton-template Settings page with a theme dropdown, not drawn). UI is LTR (supportedLocales = en only) with the hard-coded mixed strings 'TicTacToe - اتحداك', 'Player1 الااعب الاول', 'Player2 الاعب الثاني' kept verbatim, including their spelling. Boards are legal positions under the coded rules (X moved first: X4 O1 X0 O8 X6, then O3 X2 wins on the 2-4-6 diagonal). In screen 3 the scores and the highlighted player are intentionally the pre-win values: the code increments the score without setState before showing the dialog, so the page under the dialog is not rebuilt. Theme is ThemeData() on an old SDK (Material 2); drawn with the iOS system font and white status-bar icons on the purple app bar. Scores 0003/0002 are sample data.
